article.headline: Grambling takes down LSU New Orleans 81-80 in OT
article.description: — Isaiah Howard scored the last two points of the game and finished with 18 points to help Grambling defeat LSU New Orleans 81-80 in overtime on Wednesday.
article.linkText: Grambling takes down LSU New Orleans 81-80 in OT

categories.description: Grambling Tigers @ LSU New Orleans Privateers

event.description: Grambling Tigers @ LSU New Orleans Privateers

keywords: Grambling Tigers @ LSU New Orleans Privateers
article.story: NEW ORLEANS -- — Isaiah Howard scored the last two points of the game and finished with 18 points to help Grambling defeat LSU New Orleans 81-80 in overtime on Wednesday. Cham Okey split a pair of free throws with 13 seconds left in OT to give LSU New Orleans an 80-79 lead. Howard ended the game with two free throws. Howard had five assists and four steals for the Tigers (3-3). Dwayne Pierce added 17 points and six assists. Hassan Washington shot 6 of 8 from the field and 3 of 5 from the free-throw line to finish with 15 points. Okey finished with 19 points, 11 rebounds and two steals for the Privateers (3-3). Nick Jones added 16 points, six rebounds, 11 assists, two steals and two blocks for New Orleans. Kahlil Singleton had 14 points. Up next Both teams play on Sunday. Grambling visits Southern Miss and New Orleans hosts FGCU. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
